title: Can You Pass This Stop Sign Quiz?
hook: Most drivers fail this stop sign quiz.

script.narration: Most drivers fail this stop sign quiz.
script.visual_search: car approaching red stop sign fast

script.narration: When you reach a stop sign, where must you stop first? A, right next to the sign. B, at the white line. Or C, past the crosswalk? Think fast—three, two, one.
script.visual_search: intersection white stop line road view

script.narration: The answer is B, at the white stop line. Stopping past it blocks crosswalks, and stopping only at the sign often leaves you blind to traffic. No line? Stop before the crosswalk.
script.visual_search: car stopped properly at white stop line

script.narration: Like and follow for daily driving tips! Did you guess B? Comment yes or no, because...
script.visual_search: city traffic at intersection from driver view

description:
Can you pass this quick stop sign driving quiz? Knowing exactly where to stop at an intersection helps beginners pass their driving test and keeps pedestrians safe.

If there is a white stop line, always stop completely before your front bumper crosses it. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk.

Subscribe to Learn in 60 Seconds for more quick driving tips for new drivers in the USA!
tags: where to stop at a stop sign
why_it_will_work: Targets the trending 'stop sign' keyword alongside high-volume searches for beginner driving tips in the USA, using an interactive quiz format that boosts comments and watch time.
quality_problems: fact-check: Unverified and exaggerated claim that 'most drivers fail this stop sign quiz'; Stop sign and road marking rules (such as white stop lines) vary by country and jurisdiction without specifying a location; Misleading claim that stopping at the sign leaves you blind compared to stopping at the white line, as drivers often cannot see cross traffic from the stop line either and must creep forward after stopping
